note: Private IPA 621 on the delivered and verified 620. MeloNX Core of run 41552490728 (source 4ad8814e), replacing the 620 GPU source-copy Core: for Hogwarts Legacy, DMA copies from a GPU-modified block-linear surface into a block-linear surface are copied on the GPU (the destination texture created only over a surface no texture overlaps; a linear destination stays on the guest path, counted), UNORM, sRGB and float formats, and precise DMA reads; for every title, the render, GPU and demand-compile threads at user-interactive QoS and a 1 GiB pipeline cache budget (the 620 SSBU main cache was full). The app sets a 64 MiB gen0 GC budget for the engine before its first load. Game box and manuals of another session: solid box relief, DS/3DS fidelity, editable back and image correction, measured print areas, GameTDB faces for Nintendo systems from the ROM id, French manuals from the Internet Archive and Nintendo Europe. RPCS3 Core 619 kept unchanged; the RPCS3 Core 621 work of another session is source-only for 622.
